title: Feature clips: a repeatable kit, then the balanced-edges copy clip
summary: A shared Windows/macOS kit for looping 5-12 s feature clips (MP4, WebM, light GIF in Git LFS under docs/demo-video/clips/), a release step (MP4 as post 1 hook, uploaded into the GitHub release), the site playing the WebM, and the first clip: raw copy with balanceEdges on.
